name: Socially Awkward
source:
Socially Awkward is a 18+ semi-linear furry visual novel focusing on emotional cues to portray the story of each individual character on certain topics and reactions.

You are Jayce (Name can be replaced). An insecure half breed cat who just started his college life. Follow his day to day  to uncover each characters' past to get to know them as well as figuring out the world around him.

[From [url=https://monchimutt.itch.io/socially-awkward]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Socially Awkward》是一部18岁以上向、半线性的兽人视觉小说，通过情绪线索，展现各个角色围绕不同话题与反应展开的故事。

你叫杰斯，名字可以修改，是一只缺乏安全感、刚刚开始大学生活的混血猫。跟随他的日常，揭开每位角色的过去，逐渐了解他们，也认识他身处的世界。

[摘自[url=https://monchimutt.itch.io/socially-awkward]Itch.io[/url]]
